text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... While I was watching race videos and reading manga—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's already morning... My eyelids are glued shut and won't open...
choice_data_list: You have to resist staying up late.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Holding back from staying up late... does that mean holding back and forcing myself to go to bed early...?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Or did you just
hold back from staying up late??

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmmmph...
I-I'm starting to lose track hereee?!

...Having stayed up all night until morning,
Winning Ticket's brain was completely fried.
